jobs.description:
Abteilungs und Einleitungstext

For our Learning & Instructional Design department, we are looking for a Specialist Learning & Instructional Design (m/f/d) to join us full-time from November 1, 2026, on a fixed-term contract until December 31, 2027, as a parental leave replacement.

Wir bieten

Work-life balance – flexible working models, including the option to work remotely, 32 days of annual leave, and our BusinessBike program
“We statt me” – a highly collaborative, team-oriented working environment with open and honest communication
“Can-do spirit” – we are looking for people who want to make a difference and drive things forward
An inspiring work environment – with plenty of room for innovative thinking and action. Ideas and initiatives for positive change are always welcome
An international environment – with a unique and active corporate network as well as a strong partnership with our Alumni Association

Ihre Aufgabe

Design and didactic development of digital teaching offerings and learning materials in close collaboration with lecturers (e.g. online modules, self-study courses, interactive learning content)
Advising, training and supporting lecturers in the use of learning platforms and digital tools
Coordination and management of projects in the field of digital teaching (planning, implementation, quality assurance, documentation, reporting)
Strategic further development of the university’s e-learning profile and its digital teaching and learning landscape (e.g. identification of needs, development of concepts, contribution to guidelines and standards)
Analysis and evaluation of existing teaching offerings (e.g. feedback, usage data), derivation of optimisation measures and implementation of innovative teaching and learning formats

Ihr Profil

Completed university degree (e.g. Education, Educational Sciences, Media Education, Instructional Design or a comparable field)
Solid experience in the design, development and implementation of digital teaching and learning scenarios (e-learning, blended learning, online courses, learning management systems)
Good knowledge of common learning platforms (ideally Canvas) and authoring tools
German and English language skills, both written and spoken, for collaboration with lecturers, international partners and for the creation of learning materials
Project management skills, reliability and a strong sense of responsibility, as well as strong advisory skills for cooperative collaboration with lecturers, students and service units

Diversity-Hinweis (Schwerbehinderten-Hinweis)

We are looking for the best. In this, we pay special attention to personality, talent, willingness to achieve and character.
We emphasise expressly that all people - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/ideology, disability, age and sexual identity - are all equally welcome here. Applicants with disabilities who have equal professional and personal aptitude will be given priority and/or training.

Kontakt Fachabteilung

Bewerbungsaufforderung

Join our team and submit your application online, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations, quoting reference number 16617.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

In the position of an AI Engineer (f/m/d) you will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control and data analysis software for laboratory devices helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample. You use your expertise building real-world AI agent systems to work in an environment where AI agents support the development of medical-grade software. In this role you will set the blueprint for AI-enabled software engineering across QIAGEN, changing how our developers, testers, architects and DevOps engineers work every day.

Your tasks include

* Design and build multi-agent workflows that automate software development lifecycle processes, from planning and design through implementation, testing and documentation.
* Translate the knowledge of our teams, including architecture decisions, domain models and business rules, into reusable, machine-readable building blocks that AI agents can work with reliably.
* Build evaluation loops that measure the quality and correctness of AI-generated outputs against the standards of a regulated environment, and continuously improve them.
* Integrate AI agents with the tools our teams rely on every day, as well as to our instruments and software products using MCP servers, Git, CI/CD pipelines and REST APIs.
* Serve as lead AI engineer, guiding and mentoring junior engineers and colleagues across the development team in adopting agentic AI in their daily work.
* Collaborate with international development teams in Poland, Spain, and Denmark to strengthen and refine your technical capabilities and personal network.

 

Your profile

* A master's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline
* 3+ years of professional experience in software and product development, including the successful delivery of complex software solutions in agile environments
* Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language and working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines and containerization
* Experience building AI agents, agentic systems or LLM-based applications, including evaluating, testing and validating AI-generated outputs
* Hands-on experience building MCP servers or clients and integrating AI agents with other systems through APIs. Knowledge of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) that allow AI agents to monitor and operate hardware through a common interface is a plus.
* Regular use of AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot
* Excellent communication skills in both English and German (C1 level)

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

As (Senior) Manager Direct Tax Compliance & Processes, you will act as a trusted business partner to management, driving efficiency and effectiveness across tax compliance, accounting, and reporting activities. You will play a key role in enhancing QIAGEN's tax compliance and governance framework, supporting our tax compliance insourcing strategy, and advancing tax quality and change management initiatives. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders while contributing to tax reporting, compliance, process optimization, and strategic tax projects across the DACH region.

* Manage direct tax return and compliance processes in collaboration with external advisors across the DACH region.

* Manage inbound and outbound withholding tax matters, including reporting and filing requirements, while identifying and implementing process improvements.
* Serve as a key business partner for Accounting, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and other internal stakeholders on tax-related matters.
* Support tax audits, tax planning activities, and corporate tax restructuring projects.

Your profile

* Strong understanding of direct tax compliance, tax accounting, and tax reporting requirements.
* Proven ability to work independently with a high level of accuracy, diligence, and quality awareness.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications as well as tax and ERP systems such as DATEV and SAP.
* Professional proficiency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

The Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology (https://www.ukaachen.de/kliniken-institute/institut-fuer-pathologie/forschung/labooratory-of-nephropathology/) is offering a

to interrogate autoimmune kidney diseases using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and bioimage analysis techniques, including deep learning

Operational area: Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology

Working hours: 75% of the collectively agreed full-time working hours (currently 38.5 hours per week)

Duration/Term of employment: Initially limited till 30.09.2029, with option of prolongation until the completion of the doctoral degree

Start date: as soon as possible

Remuneration/Rates: EG 13 (TV-L)

Project Title: Dissecting immune cell crosstalk in autoimmune kidney diseases with spatial transcriptomics and pathomics. Institute for Pathology, RWTH Aachen

Within this project the PhD candidate will interrogate immune cell crosstalk and crescent formation in patients with autoimmune kidney disease (including IgA nephropathy, ANCA-glomerulonephritis and others). The PhD candidate will learn to train and deploy histology segmentation models as part of the Aachen Digital Pathology group, as well as the downstream analysis of morphometric features in conjuncture with spatial transcriptomics.

This PhD-Program is meant to built a new generation of scientists that are rigorously trained in the development and application of cutting-edge computational tools to generate digital biomarkers with translational clinical impact. This combined skillset will enable the candidate to excel in their further academic or industry career after concluding the PhD training.

The PhD-Project is embedded within the section of Translational Nephropathology at the Institute of Pathology, offering a comprehensive training programs for PhD candidates, peer-to-peer mentoring, lectures and lab meetings on translational kidney research, as well as possibilities for networking and presentations at scientific meetings. We are an interdisciplinary and international team of scientists and clinicians with a long-standing focus and expertise in developing novel methods for digital pathology, advanced image analysis and deep learning. Our hardware equipment comprises high-end computational infrastructure, with several GPUs (NVIDIA DGX A100), CPU clusters and storage systems.

Why you should choose us?

We offer…

- 30 days of vacation per year for full-time employment
- A bonus of 3,000 euros for employees who help recruit employees in different sectors

Tasks

- Development of a pathomics model for H&E- and PAS-stained histological slides of autoimmune kidney diseases
- Application and refinement of techniques for joint analysis of pathomics and spatial transcriptomics
- Implementation of biostatistical and machine learning models for predicting clinical outcomes using joint biomarkers
- Writing scientific publications and presentation of scientific data at medical conferences

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated and curious PhD candidate who is eager to learn and apply new computational methods, takes ownership of a project, and drives it forward with a structured, reliable working style. Strong communication skills in English (Lecel C1) and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork are highly valued.

- Applicants should have a master's degree in biology, medicine, or a related field (e.g. engineering, molecular medicine, physics)
- Interested in working at the intersection of computational pathology and multi-omics. Ideally, applicants should have prior experience in either spatial transcriptomics or computer vision, ideally computational pathology approaches

We are partnering with a fast-growing e-mobility startup to recruit a Team Lead – E-Bike Mechanics for their Berlin Refurbishment Centre.
In this role, you will lead and mentor a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring the highest quality standards in e-bike refurbishment and repair. You’ll play a key part in ensuring operations run smoothly and efficiently while promoting a positive team culture. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of sustainable mobility in one of the most dynamic sectors.

Your Role

- Lead & Mentor: Provide hands-on guidance and training to a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring their continuous development and high performance.
- Technical Expertise: Act as the go-to expert for complex repairs and troubleshooting, setting the benchmark for technical excellence.
- Workflow & Efficiency: Oversee day-to-day operations, optimizing processes to ensure efficiency, productivity, and adherence to timelines.
- Quality Control: Ensure that all refurbished e-bikes meet rigorous quality standards before reaching customers.
- Problem Solving & Innovation: Identify bottlenecks in operations and implement process improvements to enhance performance and customer satisfaction.
- Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Operations, Customer Service) to streamline operations and enhance service delivery.
- Health & Safety Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and best practices are followed, maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

Your Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in e-bike mechanics, with extensive hands-on experience.
- Previous team management experience with a proven track record of mentoring and developing team members.
- Strong diagnostic and repair skills across a wide range of e-bike brands and models.
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Passion for sustainable mobility and a customer-first mindset.
- Basic PC skills (Email, MS Office).
- Good knowledge of English (German is a plus).
- Willingness to work in a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Offer

- High-impact role with responsibility for leading and mentoring a talented team of mechanics.
- Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art tools and diagnostic equipment in a comfortable environment.
- Career development opportunities with performance evaluations and the chance for promotion every six months.
- Work with a diverse range of e-bikes—gain expertise in different bike types, models, and brands.
- Competitive salary with benefits.
- No weekend work, providing you with a great work-life balance.
- Be part of a fast-growing startup in the sustainable e-mobility sector, with a mission-driven focus.
